page.overview:
What is Roshar?

Roshar is the world in which The Stormlight Archive series takes place.

The Stormlight Archive has many magic systems. For information see Stormlight Archive Magic Systems.

The world of Roshan was made up of 10 different regions in the Heraldic Epochs known as the Silver Kingdoms, however during the Era of Solitude the Kingdoms broke apart into smaller ones. The Stormlight Archive has several different races most of which don't resemble human ones.

There are a few different religions throughout Roshar but the most common one is Vorinism, which become less common the further west. Vorinism believes in a god, the creator of all men simply called The Almighty. Vorinism tells a story about the struggle between humanity and the voidbringers. According to Vorinism the voidbringers forced all of humanity out of the Tranquil Halls which is like heaven. Once you die, the afterlife a great war against the voidbringers. Not all people will fight though, because people are to continue there callings in their current life.
